description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git fast-export' command with the '--anonymize' option. It sets up a test repository, performs export and import operations, and verifies that the anonymization behaves as expected, such as omitting specific paths, tags, identities, and gitlinks.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository with the specified message.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test condition expecting success; takes a description and a command string.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines outputted matches an expected count.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or streams for differences.
